title: web-token jwt-framework 1.2.0 before 3.4.10, jwt-experimental before 3.4.10, 4.0.x before 4.0.7, and 4.1.x before…
description: A vulnerability exists in web-token jwt-framework versions before 3.4.10, jwt-experimental before 3.4.10, 4.0.x before 4.0.7, and 4.1.x before 4.1.7. The issue is a missing integrity check in the experimental Chacha20Poly1305 key-encryption algorithm, which discards the Poly1305 tag during encryption and decryption of the content encryption key. This allows attackers on the token path to modify the encrypted key without detection.
